title: [SRPO]Scape and Run: Parasites Oil
description: A food parasite mod for SRP.Add a special nether parasite variant - fried
body:
Add a special nether parasite variant - Fried.

You can find them in Nether, or translate normal to fried by Hijacked Blaze Powder.

They taste good, crispy and juicy.

So much Yummy parasites, have a good appetite!

Fried Parasites can be eat by player, and they are flameresistant.

Fried parasites:
- Fried Primitive Longarms
- Fried Primitive Yelloweye
- Fried Primitive Devourer
- Fried Primitive Viscera
- Fried Adapted Longarms
- Fried Adapted Yelloweye
- Fried Adapted Devourer
- Fried Adapted Viscera

Future Plan:
There will be more types of parasites. Like Inborns, Pures, And Even Deriveds.
